move to sidebar hide From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia (Redirected from William III of Montpellier ) William III (or in Occitan : Guilhem III ) was the Lord of Montpellier from 1025 until his death in 1058. He was the son of William II and husband of Beliardis. His son and successor was William IV . He is the last of the "shadowy" lords of Montpellier, none of whose charters are conserved in the family cartulary , the Liber instrumentorum memorialium .
